product.description: Connect your SuperSpeed USB 3.0 devices using this USB 3.0 cable from Monoprice! This cable boasts thinner 32AWG conductors and TPE jacket, making it more flexible and easier to connect.This cable features a USB 3.0 USB-C® connector on one end and a USB 3.0 USB-B connector on the other end.
